partners.mechanism_chain: Pathogenic ABCA4 variant —DISRUPTS→ ABCA4 (HGNC:34); ABCA4 (HGNC:34) —DISRUPTS→ Photoreceptor outer segment disc renewal and clearance (GO:0007579); Photoreceptor outer segment disc renewal and clearance (GO:0007579) —LEADS_TO→ Accumulation of bisretinoids (e.g., A2E) (CHEBI:11032); Accumulation of bisretinoids (e.g., A2E) (CHEBI:11032) —LEADS_TO→ Photoreceptor degeneration (HP:0000547); Accumulation of bisretinoids (e.g., A2E) (CHEBI:11032) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal dystrophy (HP:0000557).
